rules.build:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/unix" make -j"$AELTRA_PARALLEL_JOBS"
LC_ALL=C \ "${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-ar" cr libtcl8.6.a *.o && \ "${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-ar" d libtcl8.6.a tclAppInit.o && \ "${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-ranlib" libtcl8.6.a
rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/unix" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
sed -i -e"s:variable paths {}:variable paths {/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/tcltk/tcl8.6/tcl8}:" \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX"/share/tcltk/tcl8.6/tm.tcl install -d -m 755 \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX"/share/tcltk/tcl8.6/tcl8 mv "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX"/share/tcltk/tcl8/*/* \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX"/share/tcltk/tcl8.6/tcl8
install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/include/tcl8.6/tcl-private/generic" install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/include/tcl8.6/tcl-private/unix" install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/include/tcl8.6/tcl-private/compat" install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/include/tcl8.6/tcl-private/libtommath" install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/tcl8.6"
ln -sf libtcl8.6.so "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/libtcl8.6.so.0"
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR"
cp generic/*.h "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/include/tcl8.6/tcl-private/generic" cp unix/*.h "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/include/tcl8.6/tcl-private/unix" cp compat/*.h "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/include/tcl8.6/tcl-private/compat" cp libtommath/*.h "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/include/tcl8.6/tcl-private/libtommath"
mv "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/"tcl*Config.sh \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/tcl8.6" mv "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/unix/libtcl8.6.a" \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib"
